answers.core: Creating this as an addon would likely require using a different/custom `print()` method, whereas this proposal aims to make it as seamless and integrated as possible.
answers.workaround: I would expect it to require more than a few lines. A custom `print()` method which scans for node references and wraps them before passing them along to `print_rich()` could be used, although I'm not sure about how the engine would then navigate to that node when the link is clicked.

title: Convert node string representations in Output panel to links
